steps: Fine-grained token (simplest): github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens, create a token limited to the repositories and permissions the agents need, then run: switchboard connect github --auth pat --token-stdin
OAuth app (browser consent): github.com/settings/developers, New OAuth App, set the authorization callback URL to the redirect URI below
Store the OAuth app's client id and secret in the vault: switchboard vault set gh_client_id and switchboard vault set gh_client_secret
Register them: switchboard authconfig add github --client-id-ref gh_client_id --client-secret-ref gh_client_secret
notes: GitHub accepts a different loopback port than the one registered when the registered callback is a loopback address (docs: authorizing OAuth apps).
OAuth app tokens do not expire unless the app opts into expiring user tokens; then the access token lasts eight hours and the refresh token six months without use (same page).
GitHub answers token-exchange errors with HTTP 200 and an error field in the body; the engine reads the body, never the status alone.

scope_catalog.description: Full control of private and public repositories
